meta.title: Campus Field Guide
meta.description: Independent bilingual assistant for five University of Minnesota campuses.

shell.searchHint: Find places, services, events, and courses.

today.title: Your campus day, in one working view
today.summary: Upcoming public dates with explicit provenance, plus official campus shortcuts. Nothing here changes registration or campus systems.
today.offlineNote: Live catalog checks are unavailable offline. Official shortcuts will work when your connection returns.

explore.title: Find a place, service, event, or course
explore.summary: Search current public events and academic sessions alongside clearly marked official external links.
explore.openStatusNote: Open-now status is not inferred from these sources.
explore.mapAccuracyNote: No coordinates are inferred. Use the official campus map for current geographic details.

catalog.loadingCombined: Checking current public events and session dates. Official links remain available while this loads.
catalog.unavailable: This live source is temporarily unavailable. No previous live response is shown.
catalog.eventsUnavailable: Live events are temporarily unavailable; use the official events link below.
catalog.sessionsUnavailable: Academic session dates are temporarily unavailable; use the official calendar links below.
catalog.deepLinkOnly: This campus currently provides an official event link only; no event feed was requested.
catalog.noEvents: No public events were returned for {from} through {to}.
catalog.noSessions: No academic sessions were returned for {from} through {to}.
catalog.partialCoverage: Showing {count} results from a bounded live retrieval. Additional results have not been loaded.
catalog.limitedView: Showing the first {count} of {total} loaded results in Today; use Explore or the source link for more.
catalog.loadMoreFailed: More {resource} could not be loaded; the results already shown remain available.
catalog.externalStatusUnknown: Use the official site for current hours, alerts, routes, or availability.
catalog.notObserved: current status not observed by this app

plan.title: Build a week you can actually follow
plan.summary: A local planning aid, not an official registration or advising record.
plan.disclaimer: Confirm enrollment, locations, and accessibility needs in official systems.

community.title: Useful campus conversations with guardrails
community.summary: Structured demo posts for questions, housing, lost items, rides, study groups, and events.
community.scam: Never pay through an unverified link or share one-time codes.
community.noAnonymous: Anonymous posting and in-app payments are not supported.

world.title: A schematic world with a text-first route
world.summary: Project-authored approximations for orientation, never an official, accessible, or emergency route.

ai.title: Ask the reviewed campus index
ai.summary: No-key mode searches local demo records and cites every paragraph. It does not invent a live answer.
ai.private: Private vault remains hidden by default.
ai.saved: Settings saved only in this browser.

admin.title: Inspect trust, health, and moderation queues
admin.summary: Visitor mode is a read-only product demonstration. No source or moderation state is changed.

developer.title: Contracts before connectors
developer.summary: Use the generated SDK, authenticated CLI, and read-only MCP surface while keeping contract-only operations visibly separate.
developer.confirmed: Demo operation confirmed locally; no external write occurred.
developer.cliDescription: RFC 8628 login and implemented read commands

offline.title: The field guide is still here
offline.summary: You can open cached application pages and your encrypted local plan. Official links and live checks need a connection.
